title: Install mods in game, Cosmetics v2, new themes and CurseForge
summary: Find and install mods, resource packs and shaders from inside the game, with no restart. Cosmetics get a new look with wings, hats, auras, pets, shields, gloves and emotes, six new themes arrive, and CurseForge, Minecraft 1.19, real-time Friends and smooth screen sharing join in.
points: The Library in game: press Right Shift, open Library, and install mods, resource packs and shaders from Modrinth or CurseForge. Small mods work at once; for others, Flint prepares a fresh game in the background and switches you over in seconds, back in the same world, settings kept.
Cosmetics v2: capes, wings, hats, auras, pets, shields, gloves and emotes, in a new wardrobe in the launcher and in game, with outfits, an emote wheel and a Skin Changer.
Six themes everywhere: Orange, Ice Cream (light), Mint, Cherry, Passion Fruit and Blueberry, in the launcher, the main menu and Right Shift.
A lighter Right Shift menu: a see-through look with the game live around it, blur only behind the menu, and new Menu size, Menu transparency and Menu blur settings.
CurseForge in the Library, Minecraft 1.19.2 and 1.19, Friends in real time, and smooth screen sharing with Borderless fullscreen.
Flint protects your game: if one of its mods or menus runs into an error, Flint switches that part off with a short note instead of crashing Minecraft.

sections.heading: Library and launcher
points: CurseForge as a second source in the Library, for every content type, Fabric profiles only. Items from CurseForge carry a CurseForge tag.
Library tabs have clearer icons and switch instantly.
Show in folder opens the folder with that exact mod, pack or shader selected.

Settings, Minecraft: Flint FPS mods. On, new profiles start with Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling and Dynamic FPS where the version supports them. Off, new profiles start empty.
A cleaner Update button: just the version and its name, then one click to update.
A new sign-in card on Home, and News lists 1.0.3 and newer.
Discord: Rich Presence has a Website button, and the community invite is discord.gg/flintclient.
A smaller download.
Downloads: a Clear all button empties the download history (your files stay).
On 1.8.9 the Library shows only mods made for Flint's 1.8.9 (Ornithe) and adds the libraries they need.

sections.heading: Library in game
points: A Library tile in Right Shift and a Library row in Utilities: Mods, Resource Packs, Shaders and Your mods, with Modrinth or CurseForge and counts of what you have.
Resource packs and shaders land in their folders, ready to turn on, with no reload and no restart. Flint never turns them on by itself.

Small mods start working the moment they install. Other mods: Flint starts a fresh game in the background, then switches you over when you close the menu, back in the same world or server. Your last picture stays on screen during the switch, and your settings stay as they were.
Uninstalling a mod that another one needs asks first, for example Iris needs Sodium.

sections.heading: Cosmetics
points: A new wardrobe in the launcher and in game: Capes, Wings, Hats, Auras, Pets, Shields, Gloves and Emotes, with search, sorting and room for hundreds of items.
Outfits, an emote wheel, and other players' emotes in real time.
Skin Changer: add a skin by username or link, then pick it and press Apply. It changes in game at once.
Badges show only the roles you have, and you choose which one others see.
The Flint Bound and Overcharged capes show how to unlock them: join or boost the Flint Discord.
Built to stay light: cosmetics on many players cost a tiny fraction of a frame.
Store links go to the exact page: an item you don't own opens its own Store page, an empty category's Shop button opens that kind, and News opens the changelog.
Share a Store item, a creator's storefront or a creator's referral link, and the preview shows that item or storefront.

sections.heading: Menus and themes
points: Themes: Orange, Ice Cream (light vanilla), Mint, Cherry, Passion Fruit and Blueberry, with a picker in Right Shift, General, Menu.
Right Shift: the game and your HUD stay live and sharp around the menu, with sample values in the HUD preview. Menu size (Small, Medium, Large), Menu transparency and Menu blur are new settings.
Tidier quick tiles with bigger labels, including Game Folder, and the Mod Menu button next to Settings.
In-game Friends shows when a friend is typing. The duplicate chat button on the main menu is gone.
The launcher's Cosmetics and Store pages are more compact.

sections.heading: Main menu
points: Discover: partner servers and communities, with Join for servers that take your version.
A news slideshow from the Flint team, and a Join our Discord card that shows your own skin wearing the Discord reward cape.
Other mods' buttons, such as Mod Menu, Flashback and Replay Mod, as clean icons in the top-right row.

Friends settings: who can send you requests, who sees when you were last online, who can send you gifts, and your linked Discord account. On 26.2 and newer, a button opens Minecraft's own friends list.
On 1.8.9, Flint's own main menu with everything the newer versions have.

sections.heading: Mods
points: Item Customizer replaces View Model: position, rotation and size for items and empty hands, per item or category, swing and eating animations, and dropped item size. Your old settings carry over.
Crosshair: a live preview on a dark, light or scene background, 12 one-click presets, a drawing pad with brush sizes 1 to 3, and thickness and outline on every style.
Block Overlay and Block Indicator only show the block you can reach, and trapped chests and infested blocks look like normal blocks.
The Capes mod and Flint capes work together: a player with a Flint cape shows only the Flint cape, and other players keep their Capes mod cape.
New notifications: a slim, smooth style that always fits the screen.

sections.heading: Fair play
points: On Hypixel, Freelook, Camera, Minimap, World Map, Health Indicators and Team Tracker switch off, following Hypixel's allowed modifications, and the mod's card says why.
On every server, maps show no player or mob radar and no caves.
Settings have hard limits, such as zoom up to 50x, that also apply to edited config files.

sections.heading: Performance and streaming
points: Smooth screen sharing and Borderless fullscreen on every version.
Settings, Java: Memory cleaner. Official keeps Minecraft's own settings. Smooth, for 1.21.x with 4 GB or more, removes the small stutters from memory cleanup and uses more memory.
Dynamic FPS keeps a game in the background at 60 FPS instead of 1, so recordings and streams don't freeze.
Lighter per-frame work in game, faster checks before Play, and resource packs reload about three times faster.

sections.heading: Fixes
points: Elytra flight time counts Unbreaking on every version.
Shader packs start again on Minecraft 26.1 and 26.1.1.
Missing chunks on 1.8.9 are fixed.
1.8.9 mods built on Ornithe's libraries, such as Mod Menu, start correctly.
Opening Minecraft's friends list from Flint no longer crashes the game.
Flint's menus fit every screen, from small windows to 4K, and tooltips stay on the screen.

title: Real elytra wings, smooth motion blur and instant cape changes
summary: Your Flint cape now covers Minecraft's own elytra wings, Motion Blur is rebuilt to be smooth and safe with shader packs, cape changes show the moment you pick them, and every part of the main menu can be made bigger or smaller. Esc and E always work right after the Right Shift menu, and Daily Rewards has a cleaner screen.
points: Cape design on elytra now uses Minecraft's own elytra: the same shape, size and wing movement as vanilla wings, with your Flint cape's artwork on them, still or animated, on every version with elytras. The Flint Store previews show the same wings.

Changing capes is instant: the cape you pick shows at once in the launcher and in game, the last one you click wins, and the Minecraft cape no longer flashes in between. If the Store turns a change down, your last cape comes back with a message.
Capes you buy, get as a gift, get free or unlock as a creator appear in your inventory and in game without restarting Flint.

Motion Blur is rebuilt. The new Smooth mode, now the default, gives the soft trail you know from Lunar Client and feels the same at 60 or 240 FPS. Choose Smooth or Natural and a strength. It works on top of shader packs, and your old strength carries over.

Fixed: right after closing the Right Shift menu, a quick Esc or E was sometimes ignored. The pause menu and inventory now open on the first press, and a closing menu can no longer get stuck holding your keys and mouse.
A new Daily Rewards screen: your week as seven Merits in a row, today's reward marked, and one Claim button, with your streak and best streak beside it.
The Cosmetics window in game plays animated capes, shows full names, lets you search by name, and keeps big collections tidy with your worn cape first.
Uninstall from the Library: mods, resource packs and shader packs installed in your profile now have an Uninstall button right next to Installed.
Three new nametag badges: Trial Creator, VIP and Special, next to Owner, Co-Owner, Staff, Developer and Content Creator.

Utilities › Menu sizes: make each part of the main menu bigger or smaller, from 50% to 200%: the logo, the buttons, the version line, Daily Rewards, What's New, the Flint | Vanilla switch and the account bar.
Update all and update checks are much faster: Flint looks up and downloads several mods at once, every file still checked. The Content tab opens faster too.
Opening the Right Shift menu for the first time in a session no longer hitches.
News and What's new show each release's own artwork.
Flint for Mac stays on version 1.0.2 for now while we focus on Windows and Linux. Version 1.0.2 keeps working, and Mac updates will return in a future release.

sections.heading: Capes and cosmetics
points: Flint Store capes, still or animated, on every Minecraft version Flint supports, 1.8.9 included. Other Flint players see the cape you wear.

Cape design on elytra: wear an elytra and Minecraft's own wings carry your cape's artwork, the same shape, size and wing movement as vanilla wings, animated in step with the cape. Turn it off in Right Shift, Settings, Cosmetics.

Change capes in the launcher or from the Cosmetics window in game, without leaving your world or server. The cape you pick shows at once, the last one you click wins, and the Minecraft cape never flashes in between.
Capes you buy, get as a gift, get free or unlock as a creator appear in your inventory and in game without restarting Flint.
Wavy Capes: a Realistic movement that moves your cape smoothly at any frame rate, with natural gravity as you walk, run, jump, crouch and swim.
A short notice when another mod that shows its own capes, such as Capes or Essential, is on and can hide your Flint cape.
The Cosmetics page shows a 3D preview of what you wear, your items by slot with a clear None, and your Merits, orders and the Flint Store one click away.
In game, the Cosmetics window plays animated capes, shows full names, lets you search by name and keeps big collections tidy, with your worn cape first.

sections.heading: Main menu
points: Flint's own title screen, with a Flint | Vanilla switch to go back to Minecraft's menu at any time.

Menu sizes in Utilities: make each part of the main menu bigger or smaller, from 50% to 200%: the logo, the buttons, the version line, Daily Rewards, What's New, the Flint | Vanilla switch and the account bar.
Quick Play: pin up to five servers from Multiplayer to the main menu.
The What's new card opens the full notes of your Flint version with its artwork, and the Daily Rewards card shows your streak.
A new Daily Rewards screen: your week as seven Merits in a row, today's reward marked, and one Claim button, with your streak and best streak beside it.
The menu stays readable at any GUI scale and window size.

sections.heading: In game
points: The Right Shift menu: over 90 mods for HUD, PvP, visuals and quality of life, each with its own settings, on every version Flint supports. A few depend on what each Minecraft version has.
A HUD editor: drag any HUD element anywhere and size it. Armor HUD shows your armor, sword, pickaxe, axe, shield and other tools with durability text you can size.
Pick any color for any color setting: a color square, a hue bar, your recent colors and a hex box.
UHC Overlay for any item, a TNT Timer above the TNT and Subtitles with arrows to nearby sounds on every version including 1.8.9, plus a Music Player, Custom Fog and Brightness.
Add resource packs and shader packs while you play: they show up in Minecraft right away, with no restart.

Motion Blur, rebuilt: Smooth (the default) gives a soft Lunar-style trail that feels the same at any frame rate, and Natural blurs what moves. It runs on top of shader packs and leaves no smears after menus, pausing, F1, F5 or changing worlds.
Esc and E always work on the first press right after you close a Flint menu, and a closing menu can no longer get stuck holding your keys and mouse.
Flint players see a Flint mark before each other's names and in the player list, including the new Trial Creator, VIP and Special badges, and every player has one nametag, as the server intends.
When joining a server says the authentication servers are not reachable or fails to verify your name, Flint waits a moment and tries again.
Opening the Right Shift menu for the first time in a session no longer hitches.

sections.heading: Friends
points: Add Flint players by their Minecraft name, accept or decline requests, pin your favourites and chat, in the launcher and inside Minecraft on every version, 1.8.9 included.
Set yourself Online, Busy, Away or Invisible, and get a short note when a friend comes online or messages you. Each note can be turned off.
Send a friend a gift from the Flint Store.
Flint asks before you send anything that looks like a password, email, login or card number, and keeps it blurred. Flint staff will never ask for them.
Friends signs you in by itself with your Minecraft sign-in, safely: no codes to type.

sections.heading: Launcher
points: Guided setup with Microsoft sign-in, and profiles with real Minecraft and Fabric installs, each with its own memory, icon and folder named after it. Pin up to five profiles to the sidebar.

Library from Modrinth: mods, modpacks, resource packs, data packs and shaders, with dependencies handled for you and a performance preset for new profiles. Ask Flint AI to find mods, resource packs and shaders.
Uninstall right from the Library: mods, resource packs and shader packs installed in your profile have an Uninstall button next to Installed.
Update all finds mod updates by itself and now looks up and downloads several mods at once, every file still checked. Update projects lets you choose versions, read changelogs and pin a mod.
Import profiles from the Modrinth App, CurseForge, Prism, MultiMC, Lunar, Feather, Dawn, the Minecraft Launcher, GDLauncher and ATLauncher, with their mods and settings.
Skins: change your skin with a 3D preview, with classic or slim arms.
News shows Flint's releases with their own artwork. Flint comes in 17 languages.
Settings for Syncing, Java and memory, Storage and Troubleshooting. Every Minecraft version runs on the same Java and settings as the official Minecraft Launcher.
Flint updates itself, and every update's signature is checked before it installs.

sections.heading: Flint Store and Flint Creators
points: A redesigned Flint Store in Flint's black and orange: the search in the middle of the header, calmer pages and a quicker checkout.
Browse capes by colour and by 16 tags that describe their style and theme.
Animated capes start playing the moment you point at them, and only load the frames they show, so pages stay smooth.
Capes that are Free for everyone reach an open Flint launcher at its next check, with no restart.
Your Merit history names daily rewards and gifts from Flint.
The Flint Creator Program has a new look: upload a cape in five clear steps, preview it on your own Minecraft skin, edit your storefront in tabs, and keep track of your nametag badge in one place.
Creators get help on the Creator site itself, answered by the Flint team.

sections.heading: Versions and platforms
points: Flint 1.0.3 is for Windows 10 and 11 and for Linux (AppImage and .deb).
Flint for Mac stays on version 1.0.2 for now while we focus on Windows and Linux. Version 1.0.2 keeps working, and Mac updates will return in a future release.

title: Your cape on your elytra, and smoother capes
summary: Your Flint Store cape now covers your elytra wings, animated with it, as the Flint Store previews it. Change what you wear from the Right Shift menu without leaving your server, Wavy Capes moves like a real cloak, and Flint tells you when another cape mod can hide your cape.
points: Cape design on elytra: wear an elytra and your Flint Store cape becomes your wings, its design outside and its lining inside, and an animated cape plays on the wings in step with the cape. Other Flint players see it too; turn it off in Right Shift, Settings, Cosmetics

Right Shift menu: Cosmetics takes the place of Resource Packs. Pick a cape and it changes in game right away, without leaving the world or the server; other Flint players see it within a minute. Resource packs stay in MC Settings
Wavy Capes: a new Realistic movement, now the default, moves your cape smoothly at any frame rate, with natural gravity as you walk, run, jump, crouch and swim, and no more jitter or popping
A short notice when another mod that shows its own capes, such as Capes or Essential, is on and can hide your Flint cape, in the Flint app and in game
The news on Home is smaller: one compact row per release
The What’s new card in game names the version, and its notes scroll all the way down

title: First public release
summary: The first general release: Flint Friends and Flint capes inside Minecraft on every version, a redesigned Store page, a smaller and faster launcher, and fixes for the bugs players told us about.
points: Flint Friends inside Minecraft on every version, 1.8.9 included: chat, answer requests, pin friends and send gifts from the title screen, with a short note when a friend comes online or messages you
A Cosmetics window in Minecraft shows the Flint Store capes on your account and lets you wear them
Animated capes play on every version, 1.8.9 included, and in the launcher's previews
A calmer Cosmetics page: a 3D preview of what you wear, your items by slot with a clear None, and your Merit, orders and the Flint Store one click away
Add resource packs and shader packs while you play: they show up in Minecraft right away and can turn on at once, with no restart
Armor HUD: drag it anywhere in the HUD editor, change the size and weight of its durability text, and add your sword, pickaxe, axe, shield and other tools
Friends signs you in by itself with your Minecraft sign-in, safely: no codes to type, you stay signed in, and Friends opens straight away with your last list while it reconnects
With the Flint theme, the title screen's Friends button opens Flint Friends; the Vanilla theme keeps Minecraft's own
Your Flint cape shows first everywhere in the launcher, then your Minecraft cape
News opens the full article: Flint releases on flintclient.com, Minecraft releases on minecraft.net
Your friends show with their real skins, and a friend's name or message can never change how the game draws text
Type the memory a profile gets, such as 6 or 6.5 GB, instead of only dragging the slider
A smaller download: the Windows installer is about 30% smaller (15 MB instead of 22 MB)
New Minecraft versions install about a third faster (a fresh 26.3 install took 21 seconds instead of 31 on our test PC), and mods download several at once
On our test PC a new Flint profile ran 19% more frames per second than vanilla Minecraft on the same settings (822 against 690 FPS on average over 12 scenarios on 26.3 and 1.8.9)
3D Skins, Tier Tagger and chat stacking do far less work each frame, so busy lobbies stay smooth
"The authentication servers are currently not reachable" and "Failed to verify username" when joining a server: Flint waits a moment and tries again, on every version including 1.8.9
Toggle Sprint and Toggle Sneak no longer turn on by themselves after you close your inventory with the key held
Flint keys bound to a mouse side button work, and a mouse button let go inside a menu no longer stays held, so the camera and player never move by themselves
The Darkness effect from the Warden and sculk shriekers dims the screen again, as in Minecraft
Chat messages that start with "=", such as "=)", are sent as typed instead of being taken for a calculation
Elytra wings show again while you wear a Flint cape
A Flint menu that runs into an error closes instead of crashing the game
Two nametags over the same player on some servers: Flint follows the server's nametag rules, so every player has one
Flint players see each other's Flint icon again, including players a server keeps out of the player list
The sky no longer flickers with Custom Fog's No Fog or a high fog distance, and Blindness and Darkness always keep their fog

Set yourself Online, Busy, Away or Invisible, and get a note with a soft sound when a friend comes online, a request arrives or a message comes in (each can be turned off)

title: Your profiles, your icons
summary: Your profiles in the sidebar with icons of their own, any tile color, UHC Overlay items as rows of their own, and a TNT timer that stays above the TNT.
points: Your profiles in the sidebar: open the arrow on the Profiles button to see up to five, pinned ones first, then the ones you play most
Give a profile a sidebar icon: over 100 Minecraft items in groups, with a search, on a tile of any color you pick, or your own picture
Pin up to five favorites from a profile's ••• menu, and right-click one in the sidebar to open or unpin it
Profile folders are named after your profiles, like Demon-26.3, instead of random letters and numbers
UHC Overlay: items you add show up in the Scale section, each with its own size slider and a remove button
TNT Timer stays in place above the TNT and gets smaller with distance, now on every version including 1.8.9, with a Time color
UHC Overlay's item search works from the title screen too, and a button that fails no longer turns off the Right Shift menu
The launcher stops showing Running the moment your game has closed, and Flint's news has a new picture

title: Any color, any item
summary: A full color picker for every color setting, UHC Overlay for any item, and the new Flint menu on every version.
points: Pick any color: a color square, a hue bar, your recent colors and a hex box, everywhere a mod has a color
UHC Overlay: search any item of your Minecraft version, add it and choose how big it shows on the ground
UHC Overlay now works on 1.8.9 too, and item lists show each item's picture
The new Right Shift menu, with up to 95 mods, on Minecraft 1.8.9, 1.21.1, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2 and 26.3
Flint players see a Flint mark before each other's names and in the player list
Sign in to the Flint Store from the app to see your Merits and Store cosmetics
A smaller download and app: Flint now takes half the space it did

title: A cleaner right-click
summary: Right-clicking in Flint no longer opens the browser menu.
points: No more Back, Refresh, Save as and Print menu on right-click, anywhere in Flint
Copy and paste in text boxes with Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V

title: Flint on Windows
summary: The first Flint build for Windows, plus artwork for every version.
points: Flint Client now runs on Windows 10 and 11
Each Minecraft version has its own artwork in the version picker, Home and Profiles
Auto Sync saves settings correctly on Windows
Safer handling of file paths in Minecraft version data
